decisions.reason: The MeetAlfred Pro plan is an account-level prerequisite; the client decision does not change the synchronization behavior, scope, or existing attributes.
The source changes the MeetAlfred subscription plan, not the separately established Zapier Professional subscription or Zapier setup obligation.
Upgrading MeetAlfred to Pro does not necessarily resume or otherwise change the deferred LinkedIn campaign automation Requirement.
The Apollo-to-HubSpot synchronization does not depend on any stated MeetAlfred plan attribute, and its behavior remains unchanged.
The campaign domain setup obligation is unrelated to the selected MeetAlfred subscription plan.
